description: This file defines a Python class 'GitCL' that provides an interface to interact with the 'git-cl' command-line tool, including methods for running commands, triggering try jobs, fetching results, and processing try job data. It is used for managing changelists and try jobs in a build/test environment.

classes.name: GitCL
classes.description: A class providing an interface to the 'git-cl' command-line tool for managing changelists and try jobs.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the GitCL object with host, optional refresh token JSON, and current working directory.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Runs the 'git-cl' command with specified arguments and returns the output.

methods.name: trigger_try_jobs
methods.description: Triggers try jobs for specified or all try builders.

methods.name: get_issue_number
methods.description: Retrieves the issue number associated with the current changelist.

methods.name: wait_for_try_jobs
methods.description: Waits until all try jobs are finished or timeout occurs.

methods.name: latest_try_jobs
methods.description: Returns a list of latest build objects for specified builder names.

methods.name: fetch_try_results
methods.description: Fetches results of try jobs for the current changelist.
